summary.content:
Today's selection covers 86 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meta to track workers' clicks and keystrokes to train AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ‘Scattered Spider’ Member ‘Tylerb’ Pleads Guilty
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, Krebs on Security, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
